_meta.note: English UI copy. Every number is rendered from the result contract, never hard-coded.

app.title: AgroTwin
app.tagline: From the sky to the land
app.subtitle: Replay the weather this field actually lived through, compare three rotations, and see what satellites still cannot tell you.

notes.REPLAY: A saved real run, played back.
notes.SIMULATED: Generated readings. Disclosed, never presented as live.
notes.NONE: No Scout data is used in this result.

lens.title: Lens
lens.farmerDesc: Feddan, water and the next practical question.
lens.investorDesc: Profit range, loss years and the size of the band.
lens.scientistDesc: Fusion weights, effective sample size and limits.

map.title: Three fields, three climates
map.note: Schematic site map, not a georeferenced basemap. No tiles and no NASA imagery are bundled.
map.selectedNote: Only delta_01 has a contract-valid fixture result. The other two caches stay pending and are not simulated.

barcode.title: Harvest Barcode
barcode.subtitle: One stripe per historical year. Height is not a forecast; colour and letter carry the class.

legend.green: Green: profit above the amber band

timeline.title: Diagnosis timeline
timeline.subtitle: The same replay ordered by year. The dashed year is the lowest profit, not a prediction.

source.nasa: NASA product; not a field measurement.
source.computed: Computed by the AgroTwin engine from the inputs shown.
source.scout: A Verdex Scout run; read its mode badge.
source.other: Source tag supplied by the result.

rotations.title: Three rotations, shown as ranges
rotations.subtitle: Evidence, benefits, gaps and review flags travel with every card. A range is not a promise.
rotations.creditNote: A cited range, not a field measurement.

mixer.title: Priority mixer
mixer.subtitle: Move the weights to see a transparent client-side ordering. The server ranking stays authoritative.
mixer.noWinner: No clear winner: the top two are inside the tie band.

scenario.title: Scenario sliders
scenario.subtitle: Ask the API for a scenario. The fixture echoes the inputs; the engine replay is pending.
scenario.fixtureNote: These ranges remain the illustrative fixture until the replay engine is connected.
scenario.failed: The API did not answer. The bundled fixture is unchanged.

scout.title: Verdex Scout
scout.used: Scout data re-weights the historical years
scout.notUsed: No Scout data in this result
scout.noData: Post a Scout run to narrow the band. Until then, the range is unchanged.

fieldcard.title: Field Card
fieldcard.note: The message is under 600 characters, carries the mode and avoids promises.
fieldcard.messageScout: Scout: {points} readings, ESS {ess}, band {with} vs {without} mm.
fieldcard.messageNote: Ranges are not a forecast. Illustrative fixture.

lensPanel.perFeddanNote: Derived at 0.42 ha per feddan from the per-hectare fixture values.
lensPanel.essNote: Effective sample size below 5 widens the sensor error instead of pretending certainty.
lensPanel.weightsNote: Historical-year weights are shown only when Scout fusion is used.
lensPanel.authoritative: The server ranking is authoritative; the mixer is a preview.
lensPanel.worstYear: The lowest profit year in the historical replay.

footer.disclaimer: Illustrative fixture. Not a site result, not a forecast and not a promise of yield, water saving or revenue.
footer.sources: Every number carries a source tag: NASA product, computed, Scout run, quoted source or editable assumption.
footer.built: Built with NASA POWER-shaped fixtures for NASA Space Apps 2026. No NASA logos, flags or mission insignia are used.
footer.ai: AI-assisted under human review. See docs/AI_USE.md in the repository.
